name: Erik Mikkelsen
bio:
Erik's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Initially trained as a precision engineer, he found himself drawn to the high-stakes, detail-oriented world of racing after a chance encounter at a local track. His meticulous nature and keen eye for identifying even the most minute discrepancies quickly made him an invaluable asset to several smaller racing teams.

He joined Target Racing five years ago, where he's become known for his ability to balance a focus on immediate problem-solving with an understanding of the larger strategic picture. Erik believes that quality control isn't just about preventing failures; it's about identifying opportunities for optimization and pushing the boundaries of performance. His visionary approach often leads to innovative solutions that improve overall team efficiency and vehicle reliability. He is driven by a desire for perfection, and sees his role as critical to success.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed to the side with a slight wave
physical.description: Erik is of average height, with a wiry build and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Insists on using a specific brand of Danish coffee beans in the team's coffee machine.
Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously drawn diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought, often driving colleagues crazy.
